description: This file defines the interface for the CAN Interface (CanIf) module, including callback type definitions, initialization, transmission, reception, and confirmation functions for CAN messages.

methods.name: CanIf_RxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception of a CAN message.

methods.name: CanIf_TxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms transmission of a CAN message.

methods.name: CanIf_MainFunction
methods.description: Main function to perform periodic CAN Interface tasks.

methods.name: CanIf_RegisterRxIndicationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for received CAN messages.

methods.name: CanIf_RegisterTxConfirmationCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for transmission confirmations.
